document: BeaconComms Annual Comms Summit 2026 — Attendance Policies

policies.rule: All delegates must pre-register via the official event portal no later than 7 November 2026.
Photo ID (passport, driving licence, or employee badge) must be presented at registration.
Name badges must be worn visibly throughout the event. Lost badges will incur a £10 replacement fee.
Walk-in registrations are not permitted. All attendees must appear on the confirmed guest list.
Workshop sessions (Room 1, Room 2) are capped at 40 delegates each and require separate pre-registration.
The Roundtable (S010) is invitation-only with a maximum of 25 participants. Confirmation must be received by 12 November 2026.
Main Hall sessions are open to all registered delegates up to the 300-person capacity on a first-come basis.
If a session reaches capacity, delegates will be directed to the overflow viewing area in Room 4 (live video feed).
Cancellations received before 31 October 2026 will receive a full refund minus a £25 administration fee.
Cancellations received between 1–10 November 2026 will receive a 50% refund.
No refunds will be issued for cancellations after 10 November 2026 or for no-shows.
Ticket substitutions (transferring registration to another person) are permitted at no charge before 10 November 2026. After this date, a £15 transfer fee applies.
Substitutions must be notified in writing to events@beaconcomms.co.uk with the original and replacement delegate names.
Dietary requirements (vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, gluten-free, allergies) must be submitted during registration. Requests after 7 November 2026 cannot be guaranteed.
The venue is fully wheelchair accessible. Hearing loops are available in the Main Hall and Room 3.
A quiet room is available throughout the day in Room 5 for delegates who need a break from the main event.
Guide dogs and assistance animals are welcome.
BeaconComms will photograph and video-record all main stage sessions for post-event publication. By attending, delegates consent to being photographed in public areas.
Delegates wishing to opt out of photography must notify events@beaconcomms.co.uk in advance and collect a no-photo lanyard at registration.
Personal recording of sessions is permitted for private use only. Commercial use or public sharing of recordings is prohibited without written permission.
Workshop sessions may be designated as Chatham House Rule by the facilitator. No recording is permitted in those sessions without explicit consent.
All attendees are expected to behave professionally and respectfully. Harassment, discrimination, or disruptive behaviour will result in immediate removal without refund.
Complaints should be directed to the event staff in person or emailed to events@beaconcomms.co.uk within 7 days of the event.
The Evening Drinks Reception (S014) requires a separate ticket not included in standard delegate registration. Tickets are priced at £45 per person.
Smart casual dress code is enforced. The venue reserves the right to refuse entry for inappropriate attire.
The reception is for registered event delegates and named guests only. No +1s without prior approval.
